en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2), Tikadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (4) 10.2.
The Triplet on the Wholesome (Kusalattika) and the Couple on the Conditioned by a Cause (Sahetukaduka)
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause, a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause arises by way of root-cause condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause, a state that is neither unwholesome nor root-cause arises by way of root-cause condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause, [a state that is] both neither wholesome nor root-cause and neither unwholesome nor root-cause...
And states arise by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-rooted, a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-rooted arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither-unwholesome-nor-rooted, a state that is neither-wholesome-nor-rooted arises by way of root condition.

Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor root-cause, there arise states that are neither wholesome nor root-cause and states that are neither unwholesome nor root-cause by way of root-condition.
Dependent on a state that is neither indeterminate nor root-cause, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause by way of root-condition… three.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause and a state that is neither indeterminate nor root-cause, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause by way of root-condition … three.

Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause and a state that is neither unwholesome nor root-cause, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor root-cause by way of root-condition … three. (Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are fifteen;
under object-condition nine … pe … under predominance-condition nine … pe … under resultant-condition nine … pe … under non-disappearance-condition fifteen. (Full detail for all.)
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor rootless, there arises a state that is neither unwholesome nor rootless by way of root-condition … five.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor rootless, there arises a state that is neither unwholesome nor rootless by way of root-condition … five.
Dependent on a state that is neither indeterminate nor rootless, there arises a state that is neither indeterminate nor rootless by way of root-condition … five.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor rootless and neither indeterminate nor rootless, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor rootless by way of root-condition … three.
Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor rootless and neither indeterminate nor rootless, there arises a state that is neither unwholesome nor rootless by way of root-condition … three.

Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor rootless and neither unwholesome nor rootless, there arises a state that is neither wholesome nor rootless by way of root-condition … three. (Abbreviated.)

In the case of the root condition, twenty-four [factors]... pe ... in the case of the result condition, nine... pe ... in the case of the non-disappearance condition, twenty-four. (The full detail applies everywhere.)
